title: No data is the ordinary state; the meter gives no candidate, calendar governs
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule with a mileage-triggered service and has a mileage reading history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the same estimate shows on the worklist and the work-order panel).
custom_steps:
1. On a unit with no usable meter pair (No data), confirm the meter produces no candidate and does not compete.
  2. Confirm the calendar governs and the UI does not treat No data as missing data.
  3. Compare how often engine hours sit in Low/No data versus distance.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • In No data the meter produces no candidate at all and does not compete.
  • No data is the ordinary state (four units in five have no meter basis) and the UI must not treat it as missing data; the calendar governs.
  • Engine hours sit in Low and No data far more often than distance, because hours are recorded on roughly one visit in six.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S11; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
